name: basecoat-sheen checks
description: Validation manifest for sheen assets. Implements specs/05-validation-checks.spec.md. Rules grouped by severity: 'error' fails CI, 'warn' is advisory. vendor/ is excluded (validated upstream).

error.description: Execute both real sync entry points against local Git upstream/consumer fixtures; verify generated-token ignore, staging, consumer policy, byte/index preservation and old-behavior negative mutation. Fixture builder/config decoder are not DTCG/YAML validation.
Execute tagged-repository payload provenance and bounded, fail-closed public release completion with offline transport fixtures and workflow wiring checks; not live publication proof.
Operative document tables, examples and guards agree on applicability, severity and totals; negative mutations must fail. Not agent behavior or WCAG proof.
Source-only registry and shared section-4 resolver fixtures verify explicit external identity, local precedence, path boundaries and retained diagnostics.
Real source/consumer builder fixtures verify complete skill file inventories, reference-only drift, normalized text, binary hashes, ordering, and excluded local/build noise.
Source/consumer fixtures verify advisory diagnostic behavior; findings from warn-rules itself remain non-blocking.
Illustrative T01-T14 evidence-to-decision assertions and incorrect-output rejection; not rendered quality or downstream schema validation.
Every asset has all required frontmatter fields per specs 02-04.
Skill frontmatter 'name' equals its folder name.
Skill description contains USE FOR: (>=3 triggers) and DO NOT USE FOR: (>=2 anti-triggers).
Each eval has >=3 positive and >=2 negative scenarios.
DTCG schema, reference resolution, naming, WCAG contrast, theme completeness, tier discipline (spec 01 s6).
Catalog, metadata inventory, vocab registry, and per-skill specs list the same set; metadata includes skill-local payload paths and content hashes.
Every composes.skills / delegates name resolves to an existing asset.

warn.description: W04: positive accessibility scenarios without a resolved owning agent or direct specialist pair; malformed routing evidence is advisory.
High similarity between two skill descriptions.
A 'stable' asset lacking a docs page.
A component-spec / ui-states artifact missing an ARIA role/keyboard section (spec 08 s2.2).
An error/empty-state spec lacking a no-information-leak note (spec 08 s2.11).
Localized strings not using BCP 47 tags (spec 08 s2.9).
Router contract violations: missing discriminator, unknown skill/agent ref, duplicate intent (spec 09).
